title: LCB26 LINK-XTB harmonic campaign
summary: Optimize an exact ordered LCB26 geometry with resident LINK-XTB, certify the minimum, and compute its symmetry-adapted Cartesian Hessian and native SCC/Mayer descriptors.
gates: exact LCB26 atom order and starting geometry
ORACLE perception and complete SMITH SONIC optimization chart
resident LINK-XTB/MATRIX-GFN2 only; external xTB and TBLite forbidden
one displacement for coordinates certified symmetric under sign reversal
native GFN2-SCC charges and Mayer bond orders from the final state
zero significant imaginary frequencies at the certified minimum
exact requested execution target with fail-closed routing
coordinate_policy: Use the complete symmetry-adapted SONIC chart for minimum refinement and the immutable symmetry-adapted TR-free SYCART chart for the final Hessian; retain LCB26 atom order throughout.
backend_policy: KeyMaker alone authorizes resident LINK-XTB/MATRIX-GFN2 calculations. Population descriptors are SCC charges and Mayer bond orders from the same final resident state; CM5, external xTB and TBLite are forbidden.
